- All browser tabs share one fixed lo"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"cal Web User. The browser is not allowed to impersonate an Agent.
- Agent-authored tool calls derive"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" identity from the trusted DSH execution context, not from caller-provided IDs.

- The plugin stores "},{"id":"p33s8","text":"provider/model/Preset references, not provider credentials. Provider credentials stay in DSH.
